description.value: The study examined changes in whole-brain functional connectivity following real-time fMRI neurofeedback training of the right inferior frontal cortex in adolescents with ADHD, with a left parahippocampal gyrus neurofeedback group used as a control.

design.value: Randomized controlled trial with pre- and post-neurofeedback assessments and repeated fMRI-neurofeedback runs; functional connectivity changes from the first to the last analysed run were compared within and between the rIFC-neurofeedback and lPHG-neurofeedback groups.

description.value: Eighteen right-handed boys with ADHD who received fMRI-Neurofeedback training of the right inferior frontal cortex.

inclusion_criteria.value: They all met the clinical DSM-5 criteria for the diagnosis of ADHD, combined hyperactive/impulsive and inattentive or inattentive subtypes.

exclusion_criteria.value: IQ < 80, alcohol or substance abuse, neurological or comorbid psychiatric disorders, except for disruptive behaviour disorder, and MRI contraindications.

medication_status.value: Fifteen boys received stable psychostimulant administration throughout the fMRI-Neurofeedback period; methylphenidate N=13 and dexamphetamine N=2. Three patients ceased taking medication for at least seven days before baseline testing.

description.value: Thirteen ADHD boys who had to enhance another control region, the left parahippocampal gyrus.

inclusion_criteria.value: Meeting DSM-5 criteria for the diagnosis of ADHD, combined hyperactive/impulsive and inattentive or inattentive subtypes.

exclusion_criteria.value: IQ < 80, alcohol or substance abuse, neurological or comorbid psychiatric disorders, except for disruptive behaviour disorder, and MRI contraindications.

recruitment_method.value: recruited and assessed in the same way

medication_status.value: Nine control boys received stable psychostimulant administration throughout the fMRI-Neurofeedback period; methylphenidate N=9. Three ceased taking medication for at least seven days before baseline testing and one control boy was stimulant-naïve.

task_description.value: Each run consisted of seven rest blocks of 30 s and six activation blocks of 50 s. Participants were asked to move a rocket towards space by any means they found helpful, receiving continuous feedback about brain activation in the target ROI via the rocket video-clip.

instructions.value: You can try to concentrate on the rocket or try any other method that works for you.

stimuli.value: An underwater dolphin image during rest blocks and a video-clip of a rocket during activation blocks.

task_performance_measures.value: A score (0–10), reflecting the percentage of distance travelled through space during each run.

instrument.value: 3T General Electric MR750 MRI scanner with a 12-channel head coil

description.value: T2*-weighted gradient echo, echo-planar image sequence; 40 × 3 mm slices with a 0.3 mm slice gap, matrix size 64 × 64, 21.1 cm FOV, voxel size 3.3 × 3.3 × 3.3 mm3; body coil used for radiofrequency transmission.

pulse_sequence_type.value: T2*-weighted gradient echo, echo-planar image sequence

instrument.value: 3T General Electric MR750 MRI scanner with a 12-channel head coil

description.value: T1-weighted structural scan used as structural localizer; 196 × 1.2 mm slices, matrix size 256 × 256, 27 cm FOV, voxel size 1.05 × 1.05 × 1.2 mm3.
Data were realigned to a template using rigid body registration and then smoothed using a Gaussian filter at 7.8 mm FWHM.

steps.value: Motion correction by rigid body registration to a template
Spatial smoothing using a Gaussian filter at 7.8 mm FWHM
Transformation to standard Talairach space using rigid body and affine transformations

model_settings.value: Separate analyses tested positive and negative functional connectivity differences between the last (11th or earlier) and first fMRI-Neurofeedback run. Voxel-level p < 0.05 was followed by a data-driven cluster-level threshold producing less than one false-positive cluster per whole-brain map.

estimator.value: randomization-based tests for voxel- and cluster-wise differences

model_settings.value: Two-tailed exploratory correlations between functional connectivity changes and changes in ADHD-RS and CPRS-R clinical measures.

description.value: Rest blocks of 30 s showing an underwater dolphin image.
Activation blocks of 50 s showing a video-clip of a rocket; boys were asked to move the rocket towards space.
A 5-min run identical to the neurofeedback training runs, using the same stimuli but without feedback, consisting of four rest and three activation blocks.
fMRI-Neurofeedback of right inferior frontal cortex.
Neurofeedback training targeting the left parahippocampal gyrus.

name.value: A. Seed region Brodmann area 45 — Increased connectivity

definition.value: Positive functional connectivity changes between the last relative to the first fMRI-Neurofeedback run with Brodmann area 45 as seed region

model_representation_notes.value: Group connectivity maps were computed by determining the median correlation coefficient across subjects at each voxel.

interpretations.value: Increased functional connectivity was observed between rIFC and a cluster in right caudate/anterior cingulate cortex.

name.value: A. Seed region Brodmann area 45 — Decreased connectivity

definition.value: Decreased functional connectivity between the last relative to the first fMRI-Neurofeedback run with Brodmann area 45 as seed region

target_region.value: bilateral thalamus/ventral basal ganglia/putamen/left insula/right pallidum

model_representation_notes.value: Group connectivity maps were computed by determining the median correlation coefficient across subjects at each voxel.

interpretations.value: Decreased functional connectivity was found between rIFC and four posterior clusters comprising left parahippocampal gyrus/hippocampus/thalamus/putamen/insula; left lingual gyrus; bilateral posterior cingulate cortex/precuneus/calcarine gyrus; and thalamus, ventral basal ganglia and insula.

name.value: B. Seed region Brodmann area 44 — Increased connectivity

definition.value: Positive functional connectivity changes between the last relative to the first fMRI-Neurofeedback run in Brodmann area 44

model_representation_notes.value: Group connectivity maps were computed by determining the median correlation coefficient across subjects at each voxel.

interpretations.value: Increased functional connectivity with the right anterior cingulate cortex was revealed.

name.value: B. Seed region Brodmann area 44 — Decreased connectivity

definition.value: Negative functional connectivity changes between the last relative to the first fMRI-Neurofeedback run in Brodmann area 44

target_region.value: bilateral precuneus/posterior cingulate cortex/hippocampus/parahippocampal gyrus/thalamus/lingual gyrus

model_representation_notes.value: Group connectivity maps were computed by determining the median correlation coefficient across subjects at each voxel.

interpretations.value: Decreased functional connectivity was observed in a large cluster comprising the bilateral precuneus/posterior cingulate cortex/hippocampus/parahippocampal gyrus/thalamus/lingual gyrus.
